name: Emil
source:
Human class.
A kind-hearted girl who loves her mother more than anyone.
As a child, she suffered terribly at the hands of a witch who came to her village.
Ever since, she's harbored an intense hatred toward witches.
Still, in order to earn the reward money that's needed to get her beloved mother into a good hospital, she decides to enroll in Lilac Academy—the very place where the witches she despises reside.
